title: Face Tyros superboss
description:
Tyros, Scylla and Obsidilith are optional superboss challenges. After a Tier 8 milestone and all three victories, hold one affixed equipment item below Heirloom and use /ao_mastery upgrade. This changes the held item once; it does not give a second item. Chesed, Malkuth and Geburah are exempt Tier 5 bosses.

Face Tyros superboss.
